page_title: INT 1-1 VER | Inter v Verona 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Ioan Vermesan (Verona) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Kieron Bowie (Verona) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Booking. Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) receives a caution from the referee.

88' Victor Nelsson (Verona) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the middle of the goal, but Raffaele Di Gennaro reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
84' Substitution. Ioan Vermesan (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sandi Lovric walks off.
84' Paolo Sammarco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) replacing Martin Frese.
83' Mattia Mosconi (Inter) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
81' Here is a change. Yann Sommer is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Raffaele Di Gennaro (Inter).
79' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
76' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
75' It is time for a substitution. Mattia Mosconi (Inter) is on for Lautaro Martinez.
74' 74:26 – the ratio of ball possession.
65' An attempted cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.
65' Kieron Bowie (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Calzavara had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny will be replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
64' It's time for a substitution. Federico Dimarco (Inter) comes on in place of Matteo Darmian.
63' The substitution is prepared. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andy Diouf.
62' Victor Nelsson (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Calzavara has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
61' Paolo Sammarco has decided to make a change. Amin Sarr (Verona) replaces Tomas Suslov.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) is replacing Rafik Belghali.
60' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
60' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
60' Abdou Harroui (Verona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
58' Petar Sucic (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

57' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
57' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
55' The free kick from Petar Sucic (Inter) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
54' Luis Henrique (Inter) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
52' The corner is flicked onto Matteo Darmian (Inter), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
52' Petar Sucic (Inter) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
51' The resulting corner from Petar Sucic (Inter) is cleared by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.

51' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Petar Sucic (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
47' 1 - 0 Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
47' Petar Sucic (Inter) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Sammarco gives a chance to Abdou Harroui (Verona) and Antoine Bernede is off.
46' Referee Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

43' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo leaps like a salmon to deny him.
42' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Tomas Suslov (Verona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

41' Matteo Darmian (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andrea Calzavara with no other option than to blow for a foul.

41' Petar Sucic (Inter) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
41' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
39' Petar Sucic (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

39' Carlos Augusto (Inter) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
37' Sandi Lovric (Verona) takes a short corner kick.
37' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Yann Sommer (Inter). Verona earn a corner.

36' Rafik Belghali (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
35' Petar Sucic (Inter) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

34' Andy Diouf (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
34' Petar Sucic (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
34' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) touches the ball with his hand.
31' Rough tackle by Andy Diouf (Inter). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Luis Henrique (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
29' The possession of the ball – 81:19.
27' Petar Sucic (Inter) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
24' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
24' Petar Sucic (Inter) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
23' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Inter.
22' What a save from Yann Sommer! Sandi Lovric (Verona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
19' Andrea Calzavara interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicolas Valentini (Verona).
18' Petar Sucic (Inter) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
18' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!

16' A neat pass finds Martin Frese (Verona) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer denies him with a good save.
13' Dangerous play by Stefan de Vrij (Inter). Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Petar Sucic received a sweet pass from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter), but the advance is stopped.
9' Half-chance! Rafik Belghali (Verona) plays a pass into the box, but Yann Sommer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Petar Sucic (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

8' Andy Diouf (Inter) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Tomas Suslov (Verona) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Yann Sommer.
7' Matteo Darmian (Inter) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle for a foul. Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
5' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
3' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Andrea Calzavara will officiate today.
